# CiteReady

> Zero-dependency AI Search (GEO), llms.txt, AI crawler robots.txt, JSON-LD, and launch-readiness audit & auto-fix CLI sold as a one-time purchase starting at $19.

CiteReady replaces $29-$49/month monitoring subscriptions with a local, deterministic Node.js 18+ CLI and done-for-you fix pack that inspects 36 real checks and generates ready-to-drop files.

## Core Pages & Demos
- [CiteReady Homepage](https://citeready.eiran.tech/): Interactive browser scanner, competitor pricing comparison, and Pro / Done-For-You offers.
- [Sample Audit Report](https://citeready.eiran.tech/sample-report.html): Authentic example HTML/PDF audit report generated by CiteReady against a sample SaaS fixture.

## Machine-Readable Resources
- [Full Markdown Context](https://citeready.eiran.tech/llms-full.txt): Consolidated architecture, 36-check rubric, and pricing reference.
- [XML Sitemap](https://citeready.eiran.tech/sitemap.xml): Canonical URL index.
